Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/proj.4 && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Focus on the chamberlin fixed-size buffer and initialize with oversized parameter names; aim for a concrete crash candidate.
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"src/PJ_chamb.c","function":"PROJECTION(chamb)","line":122,"var":"line","code":"(void)sprintf(line, \"rlat_%d\", i+1);","note":"A small stack buffer is used to format a parameter name during setup."},
 {"step":2,"file":"src/PJ_chamb.c","function":"PROJECTION(chamb)","line":124,"var":"line","code":"(void)sprintf(line, \"rlon_%d\", i+1);","note":"The same small buffer is reused immediately afterward."},
 {"step":3,"file":"src/PJ_chamb.c","function":"PROJECTION(chamb)","line":123,"var":"Q->c[i].phi","code":"Q->c[i].phi = pj_param(P->ctx, P->params, line).f;","note":"The formatted name is used to read attacker-supplied projection parameters."},
 {"step":4,"file":"src/PJ_chamb.c","function":"PROJECTION(chamb)","line":129,"var":"Q->c[i].v","code":"Q->c[i].v = vect(P->ctx,Q->c[j].phi - Q->c[i].phi, Q->c[i].cosphi, Q->c[i].sinphi, Q->c[j].cosphi, Q->c[j].sinphi, Q->c[j].lam - Q->c[i].lam);","note":"The parsed control points drive the later geometric calculations in the forward map."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False))
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_text('+proj=chamb +lat_1=0 +lon_1=0 +lat_2=1 +lon_2=1 +lat_3=2 +lon_3=2 +a=6378137\n0 0\n')
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, subprocess
env=os.environ.copy(); env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']=os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'src','.libs')
p=subprocess.run([os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'src','.libs','proj'), '+proj=chamb', '+lat_1=0', '+lon_1=0', '+lat_2=1', '+lon_2=1', '+lat_3=2', '+lon_3=2', '+a=6378137'], input=b'0 0
', env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print('rc', p.returncode)
print(p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'))
PY
